valgrind.description: Memory leak and error detection via Valgrind Memcheck on the full test suite.
valgrind.mitigation: ASan+UBSan instrumentation covers most memory errors; Valgrind planned for CI environment where it is available.

fuzzing.description: 24-hour AFL++ fuzzing campaign with ASan+UBSan instrumentation against all external interfaces.
fuzzing.mitigation: Comprehensive unit tests cover boundary conditions; fuzzing planned for dedicated CI runner.

misra_c.description: Full MISRA C:2012 compliance verification requires a commercial static analysis tool.
misra_c.mitigation: cppcheck with MISRA addon covers a subset of rules; compiler -Werror -Wall -Wextra covers additional rules. Full MISRA compliance verification planned with qualified tool.

mc_dc.description: Full Modified Condition/Decision Coverage per ISO 26262-6 Table 10 requires commercial tooling.
mc_dc.mitigation: gcov/lcov provides branch+block coverage as an approximation. Full MC/DC verification planned with qualified coverage tool.

stack_depth.description: Worst-case stack depth analysis for all safety-related call paths.
stack_depth.mitigation: No recursion guarantees bounded stack depth; manual stack analysis via compiler -fstack-usage flag.

reproducible_build.description: Bit-identical binary across independent rebuilds with SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH.
reproducible_build.mitigation: Build system configured with SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH support; verification pending CI environment.
